chicken-korma.source: BBC Good Food (serves 4, plus about 75g dry rice per portion added by us)
chicken-korma.note: We serve with 75g dry rice per portion, original is the curry alone, and sultanas are left out.

easy-butter-chicken.source: BBC Good Food (serves 4, plus about 75g dry rice per portion added by us)
easy-butter-chicken.note: Original has no rice or naan in the figure; we serve with rice, and fenugreek and garam masala are left out.

chinese-chicken-curry.source: BBC Good Food (serves 4, plus about 75g dry rice per portion added by us)
chinese-chicken-curry.note: We serve with 75g dry rice per portion; turmeric and sugar are left out.

spanish-chicken-stew.source: BBC Good Food (serves 4, plus about 75g dry rice per portion added by us)
spanish-chicken-stew.note: We serve with 75g dry rice per portion; olives are left out.

curried-satay-noodles.note: Egg noodles stand in for wholewheat noodles.

prawn-harissa-spaghetti.note: Cooked prawns stand in for raw ones, so they are only heated through.

chicken-katsu-curry.note: Original has an almond crust and a homemade spiced sauce; we use panko and a ready katsu sauce.

healthy-seafood-spaghetti.note: Fennel swapped for celery, wholemeal spaghetti for regular and parsley for basil.

turkey-cranberry-wrap.note: Plain wrap and a little more turkey than the original low-calorie flatbread.

caprese-sandwich.note: Farmhouse bread stands in for toasted ciabatta, and balsamic glaze for vinegar.

chicken-caprese-sandwich.note: Less butter and cheese than the original.

chicken-salad-tostadas.note: Oven-crisped protein wraps stand in for tostada shells and soured cream for the kit dressing.
